pairs: Hi sunt reges, quos percusserunt filii Israël,
These are the kings whom the sons of Israel struck down,
et possederunt terram eorum trans Jordanem ad solis ortum,
and whose land they possessed beyond the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
a torrente Arnon usque ad montem Hermon,
from the torrent Arnon as far as mount Hermon,
et omnem orientalem plagam, quæ respicit solitudinem.
with the entire eastern region that looks out toward the wilderness:
Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
qui habitavit in Hesebon, dominatus est ab Aroër,
who lived at Heshbon, and who had dominion from Aroer,
quæ sita est super ripam torrentis Arnon,
which is situated on the bank of the torrent Arnon,
and the valley in the middle,
as far as the torrent Jabbok,
which is the border of the sons of Ammon,
Et a solitudine usque ad mare Ceneroth contra orientem,
as far as the sea of Chinneroth toward the east,
and to the Sea of the Wilderness,
ad orientalem plagam per viam quæ ducit Bethsimoth:
which is the very salty sea,
along the way that leads to Beth-jeshimoth,
and from the southern region that lies under the descending slope of Pisgah,
to the border of Og, the king of Bashan;
de reliquiis Raphaim, qui habitavit in Astaroth,
from the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth,
et dominatus est in monte Hermon,
and who had dominion on mount Hermon,
these were the borders of Sihon,
Moyses famulus Domini et filii Israël percusserunt eos,
Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the sons of Israel struck them down.
tradiditque terram eorum Moyses in possessionem Rubenitis,
And Moses delivered their land into the possession of the Reubenites,
and the one half tribe of Manasseh.
These are the kings of the land,
quos percussit Josue et filii Israël trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam,
whom Joshua and the sons of Israel struck down across the Jordan, toward the western region,
from Baalgad in the field of Lebanon,
usque ad montem cujus pars ascendit in Seir:
as far as the mountain, part of which ascends to Seir.
tradiditque eam Josue in possessionem tribubus Israël,
And Joshua delivered it as a possession to the tribes of Israel,
to each one in their divisions,
tam in montanis quam in planis atque campestribus. In Asedoth,
both in the mountains and in the plains and fields. In the descending slopes,
there too was the Hittite and the Amorite,
rex Hai, quæ est ex latere Bethel,
the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel,
the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
rex Dor et provinciæ Dor unus,
the king of Dor and of the province of Dor, one;
the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
one. All the kings were thirty-one.
